authorization: Conditional algebra and static source inspection only; no acquisition, DEV, confirmation, promotion or model execution.

branch_inspection.limits: Static source inspection only; no PEFT/Transformers runtime, anchor provenance, tensor layout, module variant, scale convention, dtype round-trip or model behavior was validated.
branch_inspection.observed_implementation: Both branches have matching source hashes for B-only weighted sequential merging and FP32 reconstructed-delta averaging. The inspected code avoids direct A/B averaging.

derived_results.name: Gauge invariance
derived_results.statement: D_i=s_i B_i A_i is invariant under B_i -> B_i R_i, A_i -> R_i^-1 A_i for any invertible R_i. Factor inner products and factor averages generally are not.

derived_results.name: Factor averaging cross terms
derived_results.statement: For barB=sum_i p_i B_i and barA=sum_j q_j A_j, barB barA=sum_ij p_i q_j B_i A_j. This differs from sum_i c_i B_i A_i without further constraints. Even one adapter averaged with itself has squared coefficients unless normalized appropriately.

derived_results.name: Exact signed concatenation
derived_results.statement: D=sum_i c_i s_i B_i A_i = [c_1 s_1 B_1 | ... | c_k s_k B_k] vertical_stack(A_1,...,A_k). Rank(D)<=sum_i rank_i; equality is possible for independent row and column subspaces. Exact representation may require a larger rank.

derived_results.name: Reconstructed Gram without dense deltas
derived_results.statement: G_ij=s_i s_j tr((B_i^T B_j)(A_j A_i^T)); for real coefficients ||sum_i c_i D_i||F^2=c^T G c and G is PSD. Zero deltas have undefined cosine and must be flagged. This measures parameter geometry, not retained skill.

derived_results.name: Conditional compression loss bound
derived_results.statement: For E=Dhat-D, if L has Hessian operator norm <=K on the entire segment from D to Dhat under Frobenius parameter norm, |L(Dhat)-L(D)|<=||gradient L(D)||F ||E||F + K ||E||F^2/2. Without those measured bounds, small factor/delta reconstruction error gives no universal retention guarantee.

derived_results.name: Floating point permutations
derived_results.statement: Real fixed-delta sums commute; sequentially rounded merges need not be bitwise invariant. The FP32 toy base1e8, da=-1e8, db=1 yields AB=1 and BA=0. This does not measure the branch composer on any model.

prospective_study_requirements: Keep each delta bound to the same exact anchor, tensor names/shapes and layer convention.
Record LoRA scale, rank, variant and any non-LoRA saved modules; reconstructed weight formula is not sufficient for arbitrary adapter variants.
Measure reconstructed-delta Gram plus functional retention; factor cosine cannot substitute for either.
If rank compression is proposed, register its rank/error policy and separate retention measurements before reading held-out results.
Record a canonical accumulation order/dtype and verify actual tensor canaries before comparison.
